findings.summary: The plan says the expected CiRecord is 'parsed by production ci_result', but parse_ci_run is in gh/client.rs and returns a CiRun, not the CiRecord that reuse_statement takes.
findings.evidence: gh/client.rs:652 parse_ci_run returns Option<CiRun>. verify.rs:60 reuse_statement takes &CiRecord, which only ci_result::resolve produces. Fix: Say how the test builds the record: call ci_result::resolve with a CiSource that returns the parse_ci_run result of the same JSON (candidate SHA, wait of 1). Or assert that the prompt contains the run address, the candidate SHA and the fixed lead text of reuse_statement.

findings.summary: The checks stage can block for up to 25 minutes with no UI output. A missing run (Ok(None)) and an unfinished run both keep polling until the bound.
findings.evidence: ci_result.rs:173-177: Ok(None) and !run.finished both `continue`. The plan prints a ci line only when a result is reused. Fix: Print one ci line when the GitHub source is chosen, for example 'ci  waiting up to <ci_wait_s>s for the CI run on athena/ci/<id>', and one line when the wait ends without a result.

findings.summary: test_support.rs is a listed deliverable (modify), but the plan says the producer may skip it, which could show up as a missing deliverable.
findings.evidence: The Expected deliverables list test_support.rs (modify). The plan's file entry says 'skip otherwise'. Fix: Commit to putting the push-run and jobs-reply JSON builders in test_support.rs, or state in the report that it was left unchanged and why.

findings.summary: The plan says the reading's class_of_work 'docs' picks kind Docs, but with capability id 'study' check_and_verify routes on 'study' (Kind::Study).
findings.evidence: run/mod.rs:1255-1259: if capability id is 'study', kind = 'study'. Either way reuse is on, since Study is not Build. Fix: Correct the reason so the producer is not misled. The behavior is unaffected.

summary: I read routing.rs, ci_result.rs (read_ci, Wait), gh/client.rs (CiBranchSource, parse_ci_run), gh/early.rs (push_ci_branch, https_github_repository), run/mod.rs (check_seam, check_and_verify at lines 1183–1311) and run/verification.rs. The plan's claims about the code are correct. The CI branch is pushed at run/mod.rs:1211, before the checks stage, so reading athena/ci/<job id> at the run_routed call works. route() sets reuse only when the checks cover fmt, clippy and test (routing.rs:85,100). The new CiSteps capability with id "study" gives Kind::Study, which is not Build, so reuse is on. read_ci sleeps with std::thread::sleep(pause) and keeps polling on Ok(None) and on unfinished runs, so a Paced wrapper with pause ZERO is a sound way to make the wait observable without touching ci_result.rs. With_ci_source using a closure correctly handles the GhClient/CiBranchSource borrow. No integration test under crates/*/tests uses a github.com origin (Grep found none), so falling back to NoCi when no ci_seam is installed in cfg(test) builds does not leave any non-cfg(test) test reaching the real gh. The demonstrations run through Athena::go with seams that exist (early_seam in gh/mod.rs:77, check_seam in run/mod.rs:1018) or that the plan adds (ci_seam). Each one asserts that the runner was called, so a test cannot pass by quietly taking the local path. The plan writes no email address anywhere: client.rs uses a '\u{40}' escape and the CHANGELOG and tests use https URLs. The remaining issues are minor: the expected verifier statement in criterion 5 needs a clear way to build the CiRecord, no progress line is printed during a wait of up to 25 minutes, test_support.rs may be left untouched even though it is a listed deliverable, and the plan has a small error about which kind applies.
